flagship.title: Company Mill and the old dam on Crabtree Creek
flagship.standfirst: A longer, steadier morning: a 5.8-mile loop through Umstead's oaks to the stone remains of a mill dam built in 1810.
flagship.why_this_week: This is the choice for a slower day with more miles. The creek is crossed on a bridge, not a ford, so a wet Sunday doesn't close the route, and the canopy takes the edge off light rain.
flagship.headline_condition: Works in light rain; Sun 40% showers

route.surface: Rocky in places, roots, several small footbridges, a few short steep pitches

access.name: Harrison Ave. entrance, Reedy Creek side
access.parking: Start from the back left corner of the lot.

dog.water: Crabtree Creek at the old dam, about a mile in
watch_for: Bikes near the Reedy Creek lot

local_trail.title: Duke Forest, Korstian Division
local_trail.line: Fire roads and footpaths down to New Hope Creek, fifteen minutes out.

away_mission.title: Raven Rock Loop, above the Cape Fear
away_mission.line: A 2.6-mile loop to the cliffs, then the stairs down to the river. A half day with a long lunch.

wildcard.title: Brumley Forest, before eight
wildcard.line: Woods and field edges ten minutes north of town, quiet if you're early.

mission.text: Let Rupert choose the way at three trail junctions, then find your way back to the loop.

memory_prompt.text: The largest acceptable stick, with Rupert for scale.

conditions.summary: Saturday partly sunny, high near 78, 30% chance of showers. Sunday mostly cloudy, high near 75, 40%.

pivot.if: Thunder in the forecast, not just showers
pivot.note: Stay close: Korstian's fire roads are an easy hour, and you can leave quickly.
